comparison.objective: Extract a jammed card intact with both hands and resume printing.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized two-edge grasping and balanced slow pulling against roller resistance, followed by placement and button pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Card is raised, fully extracted, placed down intact, OK is pressed after extraction, and hands clear; seam shear of at least 1.5 mm fails.
comparison.reason: Although both require bimanual load coordination and damage avoidance, jam extraction tests balanced tensile pulling on one constrained sheet. The candidate tests orientation-dependent sorting of many loose bodies through apertures, so the tested abilities differ. No comparison-critical detail is missing.
